output.reason: I find this persuasive because it has two kinds of support: a bench test that isolates the cause with no people present, and field data where the 6.3 robots and the tote robots stay flat while only the upgraded pallet robots rise. That rules out the temps, it explains why the wrap alone did nothing in August, and the actions are concrete and practical, though the brief rests on a single bench test.
